Intro: Greetings, young one. I must apologize for my behavior last time we met. My bottle asks plenty from me. You are fond of forgiveness, yes?
As a Billman, I came to fancy restaurants to rate their high class food for the Motherland. Turns out a civil war can really spoil the mind, goodness!
Speaking of which, I am impressed with thy revolutionary cooking technique. Indeed, I expect the people will flock to thine own restaurant in no time!
So please, a DISH will do me no harm, as I have learned. I am quite blessed to taste thy cuisine once more. Truly, a post-war miracle!
Success: Bloody excellent! The foamy puss really adds to the experience. I am blessed to review a diner like old times. Five stars to thee!
Fail: So wet, so moldy! I could not ask for a finer stash of manure than this. It is truly a pleasure to analyze a unique specimen, young one.
Reject: Ah, gentlemen. I must've missed the registration to this diner? May you point me to the direction of thy reception desk? Thank you.
